title: Advanced Monetary Economics
modules: Monetary Economics And Nature Of Money
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the case when bank rate is lowered."
The opposite is the case when bank rate is lowered.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the apex regulatory body of the Nigerian capital market."
The Securities and Exchange Commission is the apex regulatory body of the Nigerian capital market.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an institution that manages currency, money supply and interest rates of a country."
The central bank is an institution that manages currency, money supply and interest rates of a country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the base for the expansion of bank deposits and creation of money supply. (v)."
High powered money is the base for the expansion of bank deposits and creation of money supply. (v).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the apex regulatory authority for both banking and nonbanking financial institutions."
The CBN is the apex regulatory authority for both banking and nonbanking financial institutions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the common denominator which determines the rate of exchange between goods and services."
Money is the common denominator which determines the rate of exchange between goods and services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by the central bank to control the availability and cost of credit in the economy (Metu, 2018)."
Monetary policy is used by the central bank to control the availability and cost of credit in the economy (Metu, 2018).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the branches of economic study, in the fold of Macroeconomics."
Monetary Economics is one of the branches of economic study, in the fold of Macroeconomics.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial system consisting of institutions and regulations that act on the international level, as opposed to those that act on a national or regional level."
The global financial system is a financial system consisting of institutions and regulations that act on the international level, as opposed to those that act on a national or regional level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the exchange in merchandise for merchandise (Metu, 2018)."
Barter is the exchange in merchandise for merchandise (Metu, 2018).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to fixed deposits in a Deposit Money Banks which earn fixed interest rates and possess liquidity."
Time deposits refers to fixed deposits in a Deposit Money Banks which earn fixed interest rates and possess liquidity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the marketplace where buyers and sellers engage in the trade of financial securities such as bonds, derivatives, currencies, equities and other fungible financial items (Afiemo, 2013)."

The financial market is the marketplace where buyers and sellers engage in the trade of financial securities such as bonds, derivatives, currencies, equities and other fungible financial items (Afiemo, 2013).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the raising of government revenue and incurring of government expenditure."
Fiscal policy is concerned with the raising of government revenue and incurring of government expenditure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rate at which central banks lend money to DMBs."
The policy rate is the rate at which central banks lend money to DMBs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most important monetary policy tools because they are the primary determinants of changes in interest rates and the monetary base, the main source of fluctuations in the money supply."

Open Market Operations are the most important monetary policy tools because they are the primary determinants of changes in interest rates and the monetary base, the main source of fluctuations in the money supply.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up of ordinary capital and special resources with Nigeria having the largest regional contribution to its capital stock (Eze, 2017)."
The resources of AfDB are made up of ordinary capital and special resources with Nigeria having the largest regional contribution to its capital stock (Eze, 2017).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more effective method of controlling inflation than open market operations and bank rates policy."
Cash reserve ratio is a more effective method of controlling inflation than open market operations and bank rates policy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the total amount of money in circulation in a given economy at a given time."
Money supply is the total amount of money in circulation in a given economy at a given time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most liquid measure of money supply and the lowest classification of money, often denoted as M0."
The monetary base is the most liquid measure of money supply and the lowest classification of money, often denoted as M0.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that Deposit Money Banks will get less amount from the central bank."
A high discount rate means that Deposit Money Banks will get less amount from the central bank.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used by the government to produce public goods."
Revenue obtained from taxes are used by the government to produce public goods.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial intermediary that flows idle surplus resources of households as loans to people who need them for investment or productive uses."
Commercial bank is a financial intermediary that flows idle surplus resources of households as loans to people who need them for investment or productive uses.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the intermediate variables that give the monetary authorities an early signal with regard to the monetary conditions of the economy and therefore, the direction and effectiveness of monetary policy."

Monetary indicators are the intermediate variables that give the monetary authorities an early signal with regard to the monetary conditions of the economy and therefore, the direction and effectiveness of monetary policy.
fib: ______ is an international organization dedicated to providing financing, advice, and research to developing nations to aid their economic advancement.
World Bank
The World Bank World Bank is an international organization dedicated to providing financing, advice, and research to developing nations to aid their economic advancement.
______ refers to how an initial deposit can lead to a greater final increase in the total money supply.
money multiplier
The money multiplier refers to how an initial deposit can lead to a greater final increase in the total money supply.
______ is regarded as money because they can be used for the purchase of goods and services and in payment of debts.
Commercial bank deposit
Commercial bank deposit is regarded as money because they can be used for the purchase of goods and services and in payment of debts.
______ is the system that allows the transfer of money between savers and borrowers.
financial system
The financial system is the system that allows the transfer of money between savers and borrowers.
______ is a security which entitles the holders to purchase a specified number of shares at a stated price before a stated date/period.
warrant
A warrant is a security which entitles the holders to purchase a specified number of shares at a stated price before a stated date/period.
______ is the consumer price index (CPI) or some similar broad measure of cost of inputs.
price level
The price level is the consumer price index (CPI) or some similar broad measure of cost of inputs.
______ is the purchase and sale of government securities and other types of assets such as bonds, bills, etc., in the open market (Jhingan, 2011).
Open market operation
Open market operation is the purchase and sale of government securities and other types of assets such as bonds, bills, etc., in the open market (Jhingan, 2011).
______ is one of the under- employment equilibrium.
general situation
The general situation is one of the under- employment equilibrium.
______ is the coupon rate of interest and also anticipated capital gain or loss due to expected changes in the market rate of interest (Jhingan, 2011).
Yield on bond
Yield on bond is the coupon rate of interest and also anticipated capital gain or loss due to expected changes in the market rate of interest (Jhingan, 2011).
______ is considered more undesirable than a positive, favourable or surplus BOPs.
Unfavourable or deficit balance
Unfavourable or deficit balance is considered more undesirable than a positive, favourable or surplus BOPs.
______ are the intermediate variables which the monetary authorities try to influence as they believe that these target variables have a close relationship with one or more of the policy goals.
Monetary targets

Monetary targets are the intermediate variables which the monetary authorities try to influence as they believe that these target variables have a close relationship with one or more of the policy goals.

______ is defined as the sum of DMBs reserves and currency (notes and coins) held by the public and is the base for the expansion of bank deposits as well as creation of the money supply (McCallum, 1989).
High -powered money

High -powered money is defined as the sum of DMBs reserves and currency (notes and coins) held by the public and is the base for the expansion of bank deposits as well as creation of the money supply (McCallum, 1989).
______ is the process through which monetary policy decisions affects banks' ability to grant loans.
credit channel
Credit Channel The credit channel is the process through which monetary policy decisions affects banks' ability to grant loans.
______ is a country's nominal money supply adjusted for inflation.
Real money supply
Real money supply is a country's nominal money supply adjusted for inflation.
______ is the apex regulatory authority of the country's financial system.
Central Bank of Nigeria
The Central Bank of Nigeria is the apex regulatory authority of the country's financial system.
______ is the balance on visible trade.
Balance of trade
Balance of trade is the balance on visible trade.
______ is the second Bretton Woods Institution with an intergovernmental pillar supporting the structure of the world's economic and financial order.
International Monetary Fund
International Monetary Fund is the second Bretton Woods Institution with an intergovernmental pillar supporting the structure of the world's economic and financial order.
______ are the level of income, interest rate, price level, return on bonds and equities.
factors identified by Keynes theory
The factors identified by Keynes theory are the level of income, interest rate, price level, return on bonds and equities.
______ is the ultimate base of a nation's money supply and is directly controllable by the central bank.
high-powered money
The high-powered money is the ultimate base of a nation's money supply and is directly controllable by the central bank.
______ is a method of persuading and convincing the DMBs to advance credit in accordance with the central bank's directives for the interest of the economy.
Moral Suasion
Moral Suasion is a method of persuading and convincing the DMBs to advance credit in accordance with the central bank's directives for the interest of the economy.
______ is the development partner of African countries contributing to the economic and social progress of member countries. 5.0.
AfDB
The AfDB is the development partner of African countries contributing to the economic and social progress of member countries. 5.0.
______ is a self-regulatory organization and supervises the operations of the formal capital market. 6.0.
Nigerian Stock Exchange
The Nigerian Stock Exchange is a self-regulatory organization and supervises the operations of the formal capital market. 6.0.
